findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 47% of the first screen is one empty block (780×780px at 660,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: The content stops 299px short of the right edge while it starts 58px from the sidebar.
findings.fix: Let the grid fill the canvas (columns in fr units), or centre a capped canvas with equal margins. A dead strip on one side reads as unfinished.

findings.message: 8 panel borders are dark against their ground: #f26522 on #fff0e7 (2.83:1) | #d81b72 on #fceaf2 (4.21:1) | #cbd8de on #ffffff (1.46:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.message: 1 pair(s) of cards in one row end at different heights (by 378px).
findings.fix: Cards that share a row share a bottom edge: balance them by their content (the same number of rows, a block of similar height beside it), or stack them. In testing, ragged rows were marked down every time.

findings.message: Only 1 of 13 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).

findings.message: 15% of the first screen is strongly coloured.
findings.fix: Keep the screen neutral and spend colour on data and status: the studied screens sit near 3%, and only tinted styles reach 10–15%, as pale tints rather than saturated fills.
